captures.label: camp_nov16_overhead
captures.notes: Nine corrected tents form a regular three-by-three grid within the path courtyard. Farm rows, roads, pens and surrounding tree lawns are visibly distinct. Distant stockade edge fades into fog; exact spacing is established by the native/template checks.

captures.label: camp_nov16_gate
captures.notes: The gate matches the reference: three-wide log uprights, full-width horizontal beam, three fence-mounted skulls per side, and a clear eight-wide road opening. Inner grass and bushes remain beside the posts.

captures.label: camp_nov16_corrected_tent
captures.notes: The corrected north fascia now has a single lower band with the extra upper row removed. The stepped roof, entrance, hay flooring and internal furnishings remain intact.

captures.label: camp_nov16_tree_lawn
captures.notes: The former standalone corner patch is ordinary grass with complete native acacias. Trunks and crowns remain separate from the surrounding roads, crops and fenced pens.
